The adjacent JS file is the unchanged public resource codec from
https://shinycolors.enza.fun/resource_hash-b843fbfa2833205bbf8a.chunk.js
observed on 2026-10-26. It is loaded in a separate VM without Node.js globals.
The resource path scheme was verified against the current official public client.
Media retain the .m4a/.mp4 suffix; JSON and Spine atlas contents require decoding.
No account credentials or authenticated game API are used.

This is a compatibility snapshot. A future official path/codec change requires
maintenance; failed official requests currently fall back to the public mirror.
No ownership of the original game code or assets is claimed.
